svg.title: XOR: three classes under arbitrary hidden bijections with transported interventions
svg.desc: Nodes are relatively open cells; edges point downward to codimension-one faces. Each row is outgoing sign: incoming signs on inputs 00,01,10,11. Positive scaling and neuron permutations are quotiented, task symmetries retained. Finite nonempty faces only; polyhedra may be unbounded. E and O merge the even or odd input pair; I distinguishes all four inputs. Striped nodes contain I and a lower-dimensional E or O section. All original 262 nodes and 560 edges remain.

path.style: fill: #ffffff

text.style: font-weight: 500; font-size: 25px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #233248

g.text: XOR fiber | exhaustive causal recoding classes

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536071

g.text: 262 cells | 560 cover relations | 68 maximal cells | f-vector (10, 60, 116, 74, 2)

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536071

g.text: Rows: s_h : preactivation signs at 00, 01, 10, 11. Downward edges = immediate faces.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536071

g.text: s records the outgoing/suffix signs. Neuron permutations identify s={+-} with s={-+}; the four mixed components use s={-+}.
